description: NOW() is volatile — no stable golden without a frozen clock
ignore: Volatile; result depends on wall-clock time. Do not invent a golden.
Volatile date; not evaluable without a pinned evaluation instant.
Volatile random; no deterministic expected value. RAND is a later workstream; RANDARRAY is implemented separately.

description: Unseeded RANDARRAY() has no stable golden — this engine's RNG is not Excel's
ignore: Volatile; each evaluate() draws a new stream. The kernel uses xorshift64*, not Microsoft's undocumented generator, so a sequence golden would be invented. Deterministic coverage uses min=max, error cases, and a test-only EvalOptions.rng_seed hook (not a worksheet argument).
INDIRECT is volatile and not in the seed-compliant function set.

ignore: Precision-as-displayed depends on cell number format / workbook option; not representable as a stable formula golden here.
